_what: The VITE_* build constants production's front end is built with (Railway web-front's variables, plus Dockerfile.web's ARG defaults for the ones Railway leaves unset), so a candidate build reads its flags as production does. Non-secret flags only: vite_env.py refuses a value that is not a short flag. Read 2026-11-28. This is a COPY of Railway's values, so it can drift: whenever a built commit IS production's web commit, vite_env.py meta compares the candidate's entry script with production's (content hashed, they differ only when the constants or the install differ) and fails the build on a mismatch.
